newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan easy money policy helped recovery -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan easy money policy helped recovery -- BOJ.

text.p: Japan's current easy monetary policy has helped maintain the economy's recovery, Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Friday.
Matsushita said the easy money policy, along with other past policies, has led to solid capital spending in Japan.
"Therefore, the domestic economy is continuing its gradual recovery," he said.
But the governor said there were still some uncertainties among both businesses and consumers over the outlook for the economy.
"We will maintain the current monetary policy, so that we'll be able to conclude that the recovery has become certain," he said.
